effects: The signer sends msg.value in ETH to the auction contract as their bid on auction auctionID_ (_placeBid(auctionID_, msg.sender, msg.value, false)).
The signer becomes the highest bidder. The ETH stays in escrow in the contract until a higher bid refunds it to the signer, or settlement sends it to the vault.
The previous crypto highest bidder is refunded from the contract (this is a third party, not the signer).
The auction end time may be extended by extendDuration if the bid lands inside extendThreshold.
formats.shown: "Bid on auction 42" with fields Auction ID 42 and Bid amount 0.1 ETH (msg.value).

findings.title: placeBid: the interpolated intent leaves out the ETH bid amount, which only appears as a field.
findings.evidence: descriptor placeBid interpolatedIntent "Bid on auction {auctionID_}". The @.value field 'Bid amount' exists. Case 0 shows "Bid on auction 42" while 0.1 ETH leaves the wallet.

findings.title: placeBid: nothing says the ETH is escrowed and refunded automatically if the signer is outbid.
findings.evidence: FeralfileEnglishAuction._placeBid: `if (!highestBid_.fromFeralFile && highestBid_.amount > 0) payable(highestBid_.bidder).transfer(highestBid_.amount);` and _settleAuctionFund sends the winning bid to vaultAddr_.
findings.fix: Optionally reword the intent to "Place refundable auction bid".

formats.key: placeSignedBid(uint256 auctionID_,address bidder_,uint256 amount_,uint256 expiryTime_,bytes32 r_,bytes32 s_,uint8 v_)
effects: No asset of the signer moves. The function is not payable, and the bid of amount_ is recorded as paid off-chain (fromFeralFile = true) for bidder_.
bidder_ becomes the highest bidder of auctionID_. This requires a Feral File signer signature that is valid until expiryTime_.
The previous crypto highest bidder is refunded from the contract's escrow (a third party).
The auction end time may be extended.
formats.shown: "Bid 0.5 ETH on auction 42 for Receiver" with Auction ID, Bidder, Bid amount (ETH) and Signature expires.

findings.title: placeSignedBid: "Bid 0.5 ETH" suggests the signer pays ETH, but no ETH moves; the bid is recorded as paid off-chain.
findings.evidence: placeSignedBid is non-payable and calls _placeBid(auctionID_, bidder_, amount_, true). fromFeralFile=true means no on-chain funds. Case 1 screen: "Bid 0.5 ETH on auction 42 for Receiver", label 'Bid amount'.
findings.fix: Use intent "Record Feral File-signed bid" and interpolatedIntent "Record {amount_} bid (paid off-chain) on auction {auctionID_} for {bidder_}".

formats.key: registerAuctions((uint256 id,uint256 startAt,uint256 endAt,uint256 extendDuration,uint256 extendThreshold,uint256 minIncreaseFactor,uint256 minIncreaseAmount,uint256 minPrice,bool isSettled)[] auctions_)
effects: As owner, the signer creates one new auction per entry, with its id, start and end times, minimum price, extension duration and threshold, minimum increase factor and amount, and isSettled flag.
formats.shown: "Register auctions" with, per auction, the ID, minimum price, start and end time.

findings.title: registerAuctions: the bid-increment, extension rules and isSettled flag of each auction are not shown.
findings.evidence: registerAuctions stores the whole struct: `auctions[auctions_[i].id] = auctions_[i];`. The descriptor has no fields for extendDuration, extendThreshold, minIncreaseFactor, minIncreaseAmount or isSettled. isSettled=true makes the auction refuse every bid (_validateNewBid requires !auction_.isSettled).
findings.fix: Add fields: extendDuration and extendThreshold (duration), minIncreaseFactor (raw, labelled percent), minIncreaseAmount (amount), and isSettled.

findings.title: registerAuctions: separate array fields cannot be paired per auction when several are registered, and there is no interpolated intent.
findings.evidence: The fields auctions_.[].id, auctions_.[].minPrice, auctions_.[].startAt and auctions_.[].endAt are flat lists over the array. interpolatedIntent is absent.
findings.fix: Group the fields per auction element (path auctions_.[] with sequential iteration) and add an interpolatedIntent.

formats.key: settleAuction(uint256 auctionID_,address tokenAddr_,address vaultAddr_,(uint256 price,uint256 cost,uint256 expiryTime,address destination,uint256[] tokenIds,(address recipient,uint256 bps)[][] revenueShares,bool payByVaultContract) saleData_,bytes32 r_,bytes32 s_,uint8 v_)
effects: As owner, the signer marks auction auctionID_ as settled.
The winning crypto bid (the highestBids amount in storage) is sent from the contract's escrow to vaultAddr_.

tokenAddr_.buyArtworks(r_,s_,v_,saleData_) is called with no value. With payByVaultContract=true, the exhibition contract has the vault pay saleData_.price, delivers tokenIds to destination (which must be the highest bidder) and splits revenue by revenueShares.
None of the signer's own assets move.
formats.shown: "Settle auction and deliver artworks" with Auction ID, Exhibition contract, Vault, Winner, Sale price, Platform cost, Artworks, and revenue recipients and bps.

findings.title: settleAuction: the ETH sent to the vault is the stored highest bid, not the 'Sale price' shown.
findings.evidence: _settleAuctionFund: `payable(vaultAddr_).transfer(highestBid_.amount);`, where highestBid_ is read from storage. Nothing checks that saleData_.price equals highestBid_.amount. The screen shows 'Sale price' = saleData_.price.
findings.fix: Optionally relabel to "Sale price (paid from vault)". The escrow amount cannot be shown from calldata.

findings.title: settleAuction: revenue-share recipients and bps live in a nested array the runners do not iterate, and would show as unpaired lists.
findings.evidence: Descriptor paths saleData_.revenueShares.[].[].recipient and saleData_.revenueShares.[].[].bps. Case 4 has an empty revenueShares, so neither field renders.
findings.fix: Waits on runner support for nested arrays.

findings.title: settleAuction: the labels 'Platform cost' and 'deliver artworks' describe buyArtworks, whose code is in the exhibition contract and not in this directory.
findings.evidence: `IFeralfileExhibitionV4(tokenAddr_).buyArtworks(r_, s_, v_, saleData_);` is a call to an arbitrary tokenAddr_. Only an empty interface stub is in the source.
findings.fix: None needed for the signer's assets.

effects: As owner, the signer marks auction auctionID_ as settled. After this, settleAuction for the same auction reverts.
The winning crypto bid (the stored highestBids amount) is sent from the contract's escrow to vaultAddr_.
No artworks are delivered, and none of the signer's own assets move.
formats.shown: "Settle auction funds" with Auction ID and Vault.

findings.title: settleAuctionFund: the ETH amount sent to the vault comes from storage and is not shown.
findings.evidence: _settleAuctionFund: `payable(vaultAddr_).transfer(highestBid_.amount);`, where highestBid_ = highestBids[auctionID_] is read from storage.

findings.title: settleAuctionFund: the intent does not say the auction closes without delivering artworks, which blocks settleAuction later.
findings.evidence: _settleAuctionFund sets `auctions[auction_.id].isSettled = true;`. settleAuction then fails on `require(!auction_.isSettled)`. The intent reads only "Settle auction funds".
findings.fix: Use interpolatedIntent "Close auction {auctionID_} and send winning bid to {vaultAddr_} (no artwork delivery)".
